# CR-003 — PDPA consent + right-to-erasure / ความยินยอม PDPA + สิทธิขอลบข้อมูล

**Status:** approved (Boss, 2026-08-09 — direct order in planning session) · **Mode:** DDD
**Plan ref:** SmartGift `docs/implementation-plan-2026-08-09.md` §5 (ZUMP01 Phase 2) · **Design ref:** `smart-crm-design-2026-08-08.md` §3 (PDPA boundaries)

## Problem / ปัญหา

Zuri will start receiving real LINE traffic for the SmartGift tenant (CR-004). PDPA requires:
(1) recorded consent before marketing contact, (2) a working right-to-erasure. Today the
Customer model has `optOut` but no consent record, there is no erasure endpoint, and nothing
stops a broadcast/automation from reaching a customer who never consented.
Zuri กำลังจะรับ traffic จริงจาก LINE — PDPA ต้องมี (1) บันทึก consent ก่อนติดต่อการตลาด (2) กลไกลบข้อมูลที่ใช้ได้จริง
ปัจจุบันมีแค่ `optOut` ไม่มีบันทึก consent ไม่มี endpoint ลบ และไม่มีอะไรกัน broadcast ไปหาคนที่ไม่เคยยินยอม

## Change / การแก้

| # | Piece | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Prisma schema** | `Customer` + `consentAt DateTime? @map("consent_at")`, `consentSource String? @map("consent_source")` (`liff` \| `manual` \| `import`), `consentVersion String? @map("consent_version")`. New model **`ExportEvent`**: `id` uuid, `tenantId`, `eventId String @unique` (uuid), `type String` (`consent.updated` \| `customer.erased`), `payload Json`, `createdAt`, `@@index([tenantId, createdAt])` — the outbound feed CR-008's `GET /api/export/events` will read; **payload carries ids/timestamps only, never name/phone/email** (PII local_only rule). |
| 2 | **`src/lib/repositories/consentRepo.js`** (new) | `recordConsent({ tenantId, customerId, source, version })` → update Customer + insert ExportEvent `consent.updated`; `eraseCustomer({ tenantId, customerId, actorEmployeeId })` → anonymize + cascade (below) + insert ExportEvent `customer.erased` `{ customerId, erasedAt, actorEmployeeId }`. Both in one `$transaction`. |
| 3 | **Erasure semantics** | Customer row: `name → "[ERASED]"`, `email/phonePrimary/phoneSecondary/lineId/facebookId/facebookName → null`, `tags → []`, `intelligence → null`, `optOut → true`, `deletedAt → now` (soft-delete stays — id must survive so orders/invoices keep referential integrity). Delete `CustomerProfile` + `CustomerInsight` rows. Conversations: `participantId → null` (the LINE/FB id copied onto `Conversation` is a direct re-contact channel — clearing it on `Customer` alone leaves the customer reachable, defeating the erasure). CustomerActivity: `payload → {}` for this customer's timeline rows (past entries can embed name/tag/note text). **Orders/Invoices/Transactions are retained** (Thai accounting-law retention, legal basis: legal obligation) — they reference the anonymized id. Messages: `Message` rows in this customer's conversations get `content → "[ERASED]"` only when `body.eraseMessages === true` (default false; heavy op, Boss decides per request). CR-006 (2026-08-09): `CustomerProfile` now also carries gift-commerce firmographics (`companyName`/`industry`/`occasionPref`) — the full-row delete above already covers them, so this coverage is deliberate rather than accidental. |
| 4 | **`POST /api/customers/[id]/erase`** (new route) | `withAuth`, allowed roles `OWNER`/`MANAGER` only. Body `{ confirm: "<customerId>", eraseMessages?: boolean }` — `confirm` must equal the id (typed confirmation, no accidental erase). 404 if not in tenant; 409 if already erased (`deletedAt` set + name already `[ERASED]`). Response `{ erased: true, eventId }`. |
| 5 | **`POST /api/liff/consent`** (new route) | Follows the existing `src/app/api/liff/*` auth pattern (LIFF idToken → LINE profile → resolve customer by `lineId` within tenant). Body `{ consentVersion }`. Records consent via repo. Idempotent — re-consent updates `consentAt/version`. |
| 6 | **LIFF consent page** `src/app/(liff)/liff/consent/page.jsx` (new) | Thai-first privacy notice (short: what we collect, why, how to withdraw — link to full policy), single consent button calling the API, success state. Follow the visual pattern of existing `(liff)` pages. `consentVersion` displayed (constant `CONSENT_VERSION = "2026-08-v1"` in `src/lib/consent.js`). |
| 7 | **Consent gate** `src/lib/consent.js` (new) | `CONSENT_VERSION` + `canMarketTo(customer)` → `Boolean(customer?.consentAt) && !customer.optOut && !customer.deletedAt`. Wire into: (a) `src/app/api/workers/campaign-broadcast/route.js` — filter recipients through `canMarketTo`, log `{ skippedNoConsent }` count; (b) automation engine outbound send action (`src/lib/automationEngine*` send/notify actions targeting customers) — same filter. **Service messages (order status replies in an open conversation) are NOT gated** — only marketing sends (broadcast/automation campaigns). |
| 8 | **Tests** | consentRepo (record + erase transaction + event rows, PII-free payload assertion), erase route (role deny, confirm mismatch 400, happy path, double-erase 409), consent route (records + idempotent), `canMarketTo` truth table, broadcast filter (mixed list → only consented get sent + skip count). Follow existing route-test mock patterns. |

## Acceptance Criteria / เกณฑ์ยอมรับ

- **AC1** Given a customer with `consentAt = null`, When a campaign broadcast or automation
  marketing send runs, Then that customer is skipped and the skip is counted in the run log.
- **AC2** Given a LIFF consent submission, Then `consentAt/consentSource/consentVersion` are set
  and an `ExportEvent(consent.updated)` row exists — and re-submission updates, not duplicates.
- **AC3** Given an OWNER calls erase with matching `confirm`, Then the customer row is anonymized
  per §3, profile+insight rows are gone, an `ExportEvent(customer.erased)` exists, and a second
  call returns 409. A STAFF call returns 403.
- **AC4** No ExportEvent payload contains name/phone/email — asserted in tests.
- **AC5** `npm run lint` + targeted vitest green; full suite no new failures.

## Out of scope / นอกขอบเขต

DPA signing (gate of CR-004, not code), `GET /api/export/events` reader (CR-008), historical
customer import, consent for Facebook channel (LINE-first; FB follows in a later CR), rich
consent-preference granularity (single marketing-consent bit for now), backfill of existing
customers (all remain non-consented until they consent — correct default).

**Residual**: staff `Task` titles/descriptions created before erasure may embed the customer's
name (e.g. a follow-up task titled "Call Somchai back") — `eraseCustomer` does not scan or scrub
free-text `Task` content. Cleanup requires a content-scan pass across `Task.title`/`description`,
deferred to a follow-up CR (Boss ruling, 2026-08-09 review gate).

## Rollout / การปล่อย

Schema change is additive (nullable columns + new table) → `db:push:LOCAL_ONLY` in dev; prod
follows the migration runbook. Deploy order inside W33-W34: CR-003 merges BEFORE CR-004 opens
the LINE OA to real traffic (G1 gate: no real traffic before consent live).
